author: aditsangani (AI-assisted)
summary: Evaluate manual schematic signal ambiguity, track loss and digit outputs
details: Add a deterministic offline evaluator, seven accounting/failure-evidence tests, per-frame report and interpretation. All 309 required-output checks matched across 127 correlated synthetic scenarios, including cold/warm ambiguity, target/ROI changes, flashing, expiry and 100 numeric layouts. OCR numeric exact-match is 103/212 readable-frame observations, with 109 abstentions and zero wrong emitted values. No real-scene accuracy, training, hardware verification or production change is implied.
validation: 53 vision tests passed; evaluation CLI passed all 309 checks. Checked publishing runs repository structure, shared unit tests, changelog consistency and whitespace checks; exact-head CI inspected after push.
